page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, then one column of text with indented and centred lines, ending with a catchword-like signature "Pro-" at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Christo, vt membra capiti, tàm in pasione & miserijs, quàm in gloria & felicitate conformes reddamur. Largire itaque nobis patientiam & in vera misericordiæ tuæ fiducia constantiam, & fac, vt ea ipsa nobis elucescat per clementem crucis huius & calamitatis mitigationem, quam crucem paterna tua manus & consilium nobis imposuit, & conuerte ac dirige eam ipsam pro clementi tuæ voluntatis beneplacito ad sancti tui nominis gloriam & honorem, nostrarumque animarum perpetuá salutem & felicitate, per dilectissimum tuu filium Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum, qui hanc nobis edidit promissionem: Dico vobis, si duo ex vobis consenserint in terra, quodcunque petierint, fiet eis à patre meo, qui in cœlis est. Vbi enim sunt duo, vel tres coacti in nomine meo, illic sum in medio eorum; & nos fretos hac promissione ita precari iussit.
Largire quoque nobis constantiam & quotidianum profectum in verae & antiquae & indubitatae fidei Christiane professione:

page.notes: Printed page number "317" set in the top right, written as "3I7" in the scan. Running head "AEGROTANTIVM." with italic/small capitals. Catchword "Pro-" at lower right. The word "Pro-" is partly obscured at the page edge. Some words in the text are ambiguous due to scan quality (e.g. "Chriftum", "Iesum").
